name: chrome-a
prompt: A single premium 3D app icon glyph of a twin-engine widebody airliner, isolated on a fully transparent background, seen exactly from directly above (orthographic top-down plan view), nose pointing to the upper right corner at exactly 45 degrees, centred, filling about 78 percent of the frame. Style: like an icon Apple would design for its own products, realistic but gently stylised and chunky, simplified volumes. Material: polished chrome and brushed silver metal, mirror-like, with crisp bright specular highlights along the top of the fuselage and the wing leading edges and dark charcoal reflections on the shaded side, a strong sense of volume. Studio light from the top left. Shape: a wide, slightly plump fuselage with a soft, very round blunt nose and a smoothly tapered tail cone; wings swept back about 30 degrees, mounted at mid fuselage, with gently upturned blended winglets at the tips; exactly two round engine nacelles, one under each wing, close to the fuselage, visible below the wing; a conventional tail with a small horizontal stabiliser whose tips are rounded. Perfectly symmetric left and right. No shadow, no ground, no background.

name: chrome-b
prompt: Isolated object on a fully transparent background: a stylised chrome airliner like a premium Apple-made app icon glyph, top-down orthographic view, nose aimed at the upper right corner at 45 degrees, centred, about 78 percent of the frame. A twin-engine widebody jet with our own friendly proportions: short, wide, rounded fuselage, very round bulbous nose, wings swept back about 30 degrees with smooth blended winglets, two plump engine pods under the wings, conventional tailplane with rounded tips. Simplified, cartoonish yet realistic, every edge softly rounded like a die-cast toy. Highly polished liquid silver chrome with sharp white specular reflections and deep dark grey reflections giving strong volume, light from the top left. Symmetric wings. No shadow, no background.

name: chrome-c
prompt: Product render of a small polished chrome airliner model, used as a premium iOS app icon glyph, on a fully transparent background. Exact top view from directly above, no perspective, nose pointing up and to the right at 45 degrees, centred, filling about 78 percent of the frame. Twin-engine widebody: a broad fuselage with a rounded nose dome, moderately swept wings (about 30 degrees) ending in smoothly blended curved winglets, exactly two cylindrical engines hanging under the wings with chrome inlet lips, a horizontal tail with rounded tips at the rear. Clean simplified surfaces, no seams. Mirror-polished silver metal reflecting a dark studio with a bright softbox from the top left: crisp highlights, deep charcoal reflections, rich contrast. Perfectly symmetric. No shadow, no background, nothing else.

name: chrome-d
prompt: A chunky, simplified, polished chrome jet airliner glyph for an app icon, in the restrained, precise style of Apple's own app icons (like Find My or Maps). Fully transparent background. Seen from directly above, orthographic, heading toward the upper right at 45 degrees, centred, about 76 percent of the frame. A twin-engine widebody with soft rounded volumes: wide fuselage, round nose, wings swept 30 degrees with blended winglets, two engine nacelles mounted under the wings, conventional tail with rounded stabiliser tips. Bright liquid metal: crisp specular streaks along the spine and the leading edges, dark reflections on the far side, strong volume, studio key light from the top left. Symmetric wings. No shadow, no background.
